summary.one_liner: An Ansible playbook and collection that automates a hardened Debian/Ubuntu install of OpenClaw with Docker, Tailscale VPN, UFW firewall and Fail2ban.
summary.what_it_does: The playbook provisions a Debian 11+ or Ubuntu 20.04+ host for running OpenClaw. It sets up a UFW firewall that only opens SSH and Tailscale ports, installs Fail2ban for SSH brute-force protection, and enables unattended-upgrades for security patches. It installs Docker CE with Compose V2 for sandboxes, Node.js 22.x and pnpm, and then installs OpenClaw on the host (not containerized). In release mode it runs pnpm install -g openclaw@latest; in development mode it clones the OpenClaw repo, runs pnpm install and pnpm build, and symlinks the binary. The repo is also packaged as the openclaw.installer Ansible collection, so it can be imported into other playbooks. macOS support was removed effective 2026-02-06, and the playbook fails on Darwin.
use_cases: Automated hardened server setup for OpenClaw
Deploying OpenClaw on a Debian or Ubuntu VPS
Setting up a firewall and SSH protection on a new Linux host
Provisioning multiple servers with Ansible inventory
Running OpenClaw from source for development
Remote access to a server over Tailscale mesh VPN
how_to_run: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y ansible git
notable: Installable as the openclaw.installer Ansible collection, with a deploy playbook and an openclaw role
Release mode installs from npm; development mode builds from a git clone and adds helper aliases
Docker containers are kept from publishing ports externally via the DOCKER-USER chain, and the openclaw user is excluded from the docker group
Includes a post-install security verification that checks firewall, Fail2ban and localhost-only listening
caveats: macOS bare-metal installs are disabled; the playbook fails on Darwin
Requires Debian 11+ or Ubuntu 20.04+ target and ansible-core 2.14+ controller; older distros need manual controller setup
Onboarding a Gateway daemon and messaging providers is a separate manual step after install
